definition.name: Open-fork tester · T6-600 study model
definition.description: Compare two probe points or put the open fork around one insulated AC conductor.

parts.name: Grip and finger guard
parts.purpose: The raised rim below the fork marks the top of the hand grip.

parts.name: Open fork
parts.purpose: Rest one insulated wire at the bottom of the fork. The fork reads AC.

parts.name: Display
parts.purpose: The screen shows one reading at a time. V means volts, A means amps and Ω means ohms.

parts.name: Rotary dial
parts.purpose: Turn the dial to V for the probes, the fork symbol for one AC wire, or Ω for resistance.

parts.name: Yellow button
parts.purpose: With the dial on the fork symbol, press here to switch between amps and volts.

parts.name: HOLD
parts.purpose: Press once to keep the number on screen. Press again to see the live reading.

parts.name: Display light
parts.purpose: Press to light the screen. Press again to turn the light off.

parts.name: Rear contact pad
parts.purpose: In the lab, touching this pad gives the fork an earth reference with the black probe in its holder.

parts.name: Test probes
parts.purpose: The tips point up in their holders. Put one probe on each point to read the voltage between them.
